details: The U.S. Department of the Treasury announced further actions under "Operation Economic Outcast," a comprehensive campaign targeting Iran's global financial networks. On August 28, 2026, the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) proposed revoking correspondent banking access for Banque Misr UAE due to its alleged processing of billions for Iranian shadow-banking networks. Additionally, the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctioned more individuals and entities facilitating Iranian finance. This escalation aims to sever Iran's remaining economic ties and is expected to increase geopolitical tensions.
title: US Intensifies Economic Campaign Against Iran with New Sanctions

details: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh indicated that the central bank might need to raise interest rates in the coming months, emphasizing that inflation remains too high despite recent cooling. Speaking at the Jackson Hole symposium on August 28, 2026, Warsh stated that underlying inflation trends have not meaningfully improved, signaling a more hawkish stance than previously perceived. This has led markets to price in a higher probability of a September rate hike.
title: Fed Chair Hints at Potential Rate Hikes Amid Inflation Concerns
